newsitem.title: UK: Middlesex Holdings seeks official listing.
newsitem.headline: Middlesex Holdings seeks official listing.

text.p: Middlesex Holdings Plc said on Tuesday it was moving from the UK's Unlisted Securities Market to the official list of the London Stock Exchange.
Dealing in the shares is expected to begin on October 28.
Middlesex, which operates in the natural resources sector of the former Soviet Union as an investor and adviser, has a market capitalisation of around 50 million stg.

"This is an important step for Middlesex," said chairman Lord Owen, "which underlines the company's development over the last three years, its rapidly growing value and our belief in the opportunities that exist for growth."
